subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

She couldn’t **__get over with Thomas due to__** his addiction to alcohol.

options.text: get at with Thomas due to
get along with Thomas due to
get off with Thomas due to
get rid with Thomas due to

solution: The correct answer is **"get along with Thomas due to.**" [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • In the underlined phrase, the use of the word **"over"** distorts the meaning of the sentence. • The phrase **"get over with"** means complete an unpleasant or tedious but necessary task promptly. • किसी अप्रिय या थकाऊ लेकिन आवश्यक कार्य को तुरंत पूरा करें। • ​The correct phrase to use is** "get along."** • **​****"Get along with"** means to have a good relationship with someone. (किसी के साथ अच्छे संबंध बनाना।) • **Example**:* I cannot **get along**__ with my relatives because of their nature.* • This option makes sense in the context of the sentence, as the speaker couldn't have a good relationship with Thomas because of his addiction to alcohol.​ • Hence, the correct answer is** option 2**. **Correct sentence**: *She couldn’t __**get along with Thomas due to**__ his addiction to alcohol. * [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Option 1,** "get at with Thomas due to,"** doesn't make sense in the context of the sentence. "Get at" means to criticize or attack someone, but this doesn't fit with the rest of the sentence.(किसी की आलोचना करना या हमला करना) • Option 3,** "get off with Thomas due to," **doesn't make sense in the context of the sentence. "Get off" escape a punishment; be acquitted , but this doesn't fit with the rest of the sentence.(सज़ा से बचो; बरी किया जाए.) • Option 4, **"get rid with Thomas due to,"** doesn't make sense in the context of the sentence. "Get rid of" means to remove or dispose of something, but this doesn't fit with the rest of the sentence.(किसी चीज़ को हटाना या निपटाना) 3b:Tf53, ಸರಿಯಾದ ಉತ್ತರವೆಂದರೆ **"ಥಾಮಸ್ ಜೊತೆ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಸಂಬಂಧ ಹೊಂದಲು ಸಾಧ್ಯವಾಗಲಿಲ್ಲ."**
